fact: The first national conference on geospatial technologies for modern and sustainable farming, held on 29-30 November 2023 in Oran by the Algerian Space Agency centres, presented ASAL's agriculture projects and the Cropwatch crop-monitoring experience in Algeria, with INRAA, ONID, the Oran agricultural services directorate and BNEDER taking part.
title: إنعقاد المؤتمر الوطني الأول للتكنولوجيات الجيوفضائية لفلاحة حديثة ومستدامة CNTGA 2023
